name: High number of cases for zero Length of Stay (LOS) for major surgical procedure code
checklist: Cross Match the procedure performed with day care procedure list in reference of package master
Verify LOS as per surgical package blocked in reference to standard guidelines
Verify mandatory documents for blocked procedure
Cross Check whether patient has been released on DOR or LAMA or DAMA?
Did the patient visit hospital in emergency or OPD for treatment?
Was the patient hospitalized or not?
Was any surgery done or not? Ask details in simpler language
Was the patient conscious during surgery?
source: NHA Anti-Fraud Framework Practitioners' Guidebook, Annexure 2

name: High number of cases for zero Length of Stay (LOS) for Non Day Care Medical Packages (M1 and M2)
checklist: Cross Check whether patient has been released on DOR or LAMA or DAMA?
Cross check OPD with IPD entry records and find proportion of OPD to IPD conversion ratio
Verify whether the diagnosis were in sync with supportive investigation reports, treatment and vitals with progress notes * Detailed check for quality of care given may also be done
Did the patient visit hospital in emergency or OPD for treatment?
Was the patient hospitalized or not?
Did you stay in the hospital for more than 24 hours or were only given medication in OPD/ Emergency and released from the hospital?
Did the patient feel better at the time of discharge?
Verify the facts provided on call (Do voice/video recording/written signed statement with permission of beneficiary)
source: NHA Anti-Fraud Framework Practitioners' Guidebook, Annexure 2

name: Cases where medical management exceeds more than 10 days in non-critical cases
checklist: Cross check all day wise indoor case papers (Repeated Lab investigation, progress notes, vitals chart and treatment chart) to Justify the prolonged LOS
Verify the above with progress notes by treating doctor, nursing notes for the successive days of admission
Cross check the patient shifting register and Discharge Register with actual number of days admitted in ICU/general ward
Did the patient visit hospital in emergency or OPD for treatment?
Was the patient hospitalized or not?
For How many days were you admitted in the hospital? Days in ICU/ Days in general ward? (Ask in local and simpler language)
Did the patient feel better at the time of discharge?
Verify the facts provided on call (Do voice/video recording/written signed statement with permission of beneficiary)
source: NHA Anti-Fraud Framework Practitioners' Guidebook, Annexure 2

name: Highlight cases where a same doctor is performing surgery/ treatment in the far-away districts
checklist: Pull out the data related to doctor who has performed surgeries in different hospitals on same day
Ask for registration certificate of Treating Doctor and cross match with HR records also
Did the patient visit hospital in emergency or OPD for treatment?
Was the patient hospitalized or not?
Was any kind of surgery done or not? Ask details in simpler language
Verify the facts provided on call (Do voice/video recording/written signed statement with permission of beneficiary)
Ask for Discharge Summary and take a scan copy
Cross check registration as well as date and time of admission of all admitted patient on the same day
source: NHA Anti-Fraud Framework Practitioners' Guidebook, Annexure 2

name: Same document/ images used in more than one case
checklist: Verify the claims set where same document/ image has been used (with special emphasis on DOA, Same Family, Same First Name, Same member)
Verify whether the undertaken treatment was in sync with all hospital entry registers (OPD, IPD, Patient shifting record, Lab, Radiology and Pharmacy)
Did the patient visit hospital in emergency or OPD for treatment?
Was the patient hospitalized or not?
Were you admitted for medical management or surgical?
Verify the facts provided on call (Do voice/video recording/written signed statement with permission of beneficiary)
Follow general guidelines/steps in all process as mentioned in Medical Audit Manual
Ask for implant register of particular trendy cases and match their BAR CODE or PRODUCT CODE to one another (in case of surgery)
source: NHA Anti-Fraud Framework Practitioners' Guidebook, Annexure 2

name: Multiple cases for acute medical illness for same patient
checklist: Verify the indication for hospitalization on each admission with reference to supportive mandatory documents submitted
Verify whether the undertaken treatment was in sync with all hospital entry registers (OPD, IPD, Patient shifting record, Lab, Radiology and Pharmacy)
Compare IPD records across all suspected set of claims where same member was hospitalized
Cross check Nursing staff Roster with nursing notes found on IPD files
Cross Check Treating doctor availability with HR
Did you visit hospital in emergency or OPD for treatment?
Were you admitted in the hospital or not?
How many days did you stay in the hospital?
source: NHA Anti-Fraud Framework Practitioners' Guidebook, Annexure 2

name: Highlight cases of admission/ discharge/ surgery after death of the patient
checklist: Cross match DOA and Date of death on TMS
Cross check date of admission and date of death in all hospital entry records
Mortality report from the hospital * Detailed check for quality of care given may also be done
Ask for exact date, time and place of death from the relative of patient
Ask for Death certificate and Death Summary provided by Hospital
Follow general guidelines/steps in all process as mentioned in Medical Audit Manual
Check procedure performed as per Guidance Documents if available
source: NHA Anti-Fraud Framework Practitioners' Guidebook, Annexure 2

name: Package billed for a specialty the hospital is not empanelled for
checklist: Compare package specialty against the hospital's registry specialty list

name: Claimed amount exceeds the published package rate
checklist: Compare amount_claimed against package_amount_rs
Check whether an implant add-on is separately justified
source: Derived: Punjab SHA published HBP package master

name: Government-reserved package billed by a private hospital
checklist: Check govt_reserved flag against hospital type
Check whether a referral was recorded
source: Derived: Punjab SHA published HBP package master
